_comment: Limits calibrated from seed spread, not a flat margin: `npm run calibrate:phonemes` runs this exact gate (sampleSize words, lexicon, morphology off) on 30 seeds whose RNG streams do not overlap, then sets each limit to the worst observed value ± 3 sample SDs, rounded outward. Zero-spread metrics (generated-only mass, missing CMU phonemes) stay at 0. Re-run after an intentional distribution change and commit the new limits with that PR; see TUNING.md.
